wiki.title: Courtney Neron Misslin
wiki.extract: Courtney Brook Neron (née Misslin; born March 1979) is an American politician from Oregon. A Democrat, she represents Oregon's 13th Senate district in the Oregon Senate. This district is located in northwestern Oregon and includes portions of Clackamas County, Washington County and Yamhill County.
